articles.summary: Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (Santander CIB) has acted as Sole Arranger and Senior Lender on a landmark €150 million securitisation facility for Twinco Capital, supporting the fintech’s expansion of purchase order finance and increasing access to liquidity for SMEs across global supply chains.
articles.title: Santander CIB leads landmark €150 million securitisation facility for Twinco Capital
